Class GameConfig

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.gameLogic.GameConfig
public class GameConfig extends Object
Central repository for all static game configuration settings and constants.

This class allows for easy tuning of game balance (speed, dimensions), UI layout, and file persistence paths from a single location.
